purpose: Freeze transparent reference-economy cohorts before first multi-country empirical extraction.

cohortPolicy.universe: OECD members with required official series availability
cohortPolicy.rule: Membership is frozen before extracting outcome values. Missing observations may reduce a metric-specific analytic sample but may not be replaced ad hoc to obtain a preferred band.

referenceClasses.label: advanced diversified
referenceClasses.selectionBasis: broad advanced OECD comparison cohort; used as baseline rather than as a model-country template

referenceClasses.label: advanced manufacturing-intensive
referenceClasses.selectionBasis: advanced OECD economies retained for manufacturing-intensive comparison; manufacturing intensity must be verified from official value-added data before any sector calibration use

referenceClasses.label: resource-exposed advanced
referenceClasses.selectionBasis: OECD economies with material resource exposure; this class is a comparison cohort, not a claim of identical production structures

referenceClasses.label: high household-saving advanced
referenceClasses.selectionBasis: candidate high-saving OECD cohort; admission to a saving-rate band requires official comparable household-sector data and does not map to desiredConsumptionBudget

firstExtraction.semanticUse: cohort characterization only; not a RESOURCE/MATERIALS/CAPITAL/CONSUMER target because use-classification bridge remains required

sourceVerification.source: OECD Data Explorer — NAAG Chapter 4: Production
sourceVerification.finding: Official OECD dataset exposes annual manufacturing gross value added as percentage of gross value added for 38 reference areas and provides an SDMX API query.

sourceVerification.source: OECD Data Explorer — Annual value added and its components by economic activity
sourceVerification.finding: Detailed ISIC Rev.4 activity data include gross value added, output, intermediate consumption, wages and salaries, and operating surplus; latest page update observed in August 2026.

blockedMappings: manufacturing GVA share -> model MATERIALS share
manufacturing GVA share -> model CAPITAL share
